mapper.select: SELECT sum(mff.main_net) AS total_net, countIf(mff.main_net > 0) AS positive_cnt, count() AS total_cnt, max(mff.trade_date) AS used_date FROM main_fund_flow AS mff FINAL WHERE mff.obj_type = 'stock' AND mff.trade_date = ( SELECT max(trade_date) FROM main_fund_flow FINAL WHERE obj_type = 'stock' AND trade_date <= #{tradeDate} )
